edits.old: As a **squad member (RW-TRIBE)**, I want **the case list proved end to end on the real wave-1 services — the open cases and their owner and queue read from rwb-case through its published contract, the daily `case_list_row` rows built and replaced in one transaction in rwb-source-data by the CaseListBuildWorkflow started by `rwb.source-data.AceDataReady.v1`, the daily extract delivered to rwb-reporting by the `deliverFile` activity of rwb-integration instead of the removed data lake, and SCR-02 served in one hop by the gateway-bff composite route**, so that **the one list every team works from is dated to the ACE batch it was built from and is proven against the services that will run it, not against a fake**.
edits.new: As a **squad member (RW-TRIBE)**, I want **the case list proved end to end on the real wave-1 services — published by rwb-case as one CaseListRow per open case, carrying its account keys and the account columns of the legacy list, where rwb-case reads the account and freshness answers of RWB-P1-E1015-CON for one page, one hop with a 2 s budget, and stamps each row with the answer time as refreshedAt and the freshness answer as X-Data-As-Of with a stale flag, with `case_list_row`, its unique key, the extract file, the lake path and the Power BI data set dropped under DP-17, REC-01 and REC-05 left with RWB-P1-E1011 in rwb-source-data, and SCR-02 served in one hop by the gateway-bff composite route**, so that **the one list every team works from is dated to the ACE batch it was built from and is proven against the services that will run it, not against a fake**.

The target form of the list is fixed by the ruling on GAP-2228 (R-21867), which replaces the legacy `case_list_row` shape: the list is one CaseListRow per open case carrying its account keys and the account columns of the legacy list, published by rwb-case as a CasePage of Case items; rwb-case reads the account and freshness answers of RWB-P1-E1015-CON for one page, one hop with a 2 s budget, and stamps the row with the answer time as refreshedAt and the freshness answer as X-Data-As-Of with a stale flag; `case_list_row`, its unique key, the extract file, the lake path and the Power BI data set are dropped under DP-17; REC-01 and REC-05 stay with RWB-P1-E1011 in rwb-source-data.
